gbm_population_evidence.quote: Participants with histologically confirmed diagnosis of surgically accessible recurrent/progressive glioblastoma will be enrolled in this study

candidate_evidence.quote: To evaluate the influence of pembrolizumab on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of progressive/recurrent glioblastoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Be at first or second relapse

combination_partners: dendritic cell tumor cell lysate vaccine (ATL-DC)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To evaluate the influence of pembrolizumab on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of progressive/recurrent glioblastoma.
TIL quantification including tumor quantification of PD-1, PD-L1, CD3, CD4, CD8, Iba-I, Ki-67 measured by immunohistochemistry of FFPE tissue

role_evidence.quote: Giving pembrolizumab and ATL-DC vaccine may work better in treating patients with glioblastoma compared to ATL-DC alone.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody, immune checkpoint inhibitor
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: PD-1 blockade helping the immune system attack the cancer

agents.agent_name_registered: Dendritic Cell Tumor Cell Lysate Vaccine
agents.active_moiety: autologous tumor lysate-pulsed dendritic cell vaccine

role_evidence.quote: Dendritic Cell Tumor Cell Lysate Vaccine (other names: DC tumor cell lysate vaccine, dendritic cell-pulsed tumor cell lysate vaccine): Given ID
Patients also receive ATL-DC ID with poly ICLC IM every 2 weeks for up to 3 doses in the absence of disease progression or unacceptable toxicity.

agents.drug_class_hint: TLR3 agonist immune adjuvant (stabilised polyinosinic-polycytidylic acid, Hiltonol)

source_quote.quote: The differences of PD-1, PD-L1, CD3, CD4, CD8, Iba-I, Ki-67 protein expression level between the archival tumor (collected pre-treatment) and protocol tumor (collected post-neoadjuvant treatment) will be assessed using paired T-test

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Cell cycle-related gene expression signature in tumour
TIL density and TCR clonality (tumour and blood)

source_quote.quote: TIL (tumor infiltrating lymphocyte) density and TCR (T cell receptor) Clonality in the tumor quantitatively measured by next generation TCR sequencing

Estimating the correlation of quantitative assessments of tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) density or the interferon (IFN) gamma-associated genetic signature with clinical responses to pembrolizumab and ATL-DC in recurrent glioblastoma patients.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Tumour gene expression signature and somatic mutations (RNA-seq, NanoString IO360)

source_quote.quote: gene expression signature and somatic mutations in the tumor measured by RNA Seq and nano string IO360

coder_notes: Pembrolizumab vs placebo on a background of ATL-DC vaccine + poly ICLC in both groups. Pembrolizumab is the only investigational drug candidate; the DC vaccine is an excluded intervention type; poly ICLC (vaccine adjuvant) is given in every arm, so soc_backbone per C3. The comparator arm is a registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR (placebo), so control_arm_from_other_arms = no (no additional OTHER/EXPERIMENTAL control). Placebo is registered as 'Other: Placebo Administration' and not listed as an agent. Merck Sharp & Dohme and Oncovir appear as collaborators in the sponsor field (left to [CODE]); no text says drug supplied. PD-L1/PD-1 IHC pre vs post treatment coded pharmacodynamic and matched to pembrolizumab (not eligibility/enrichment, so no effect on primary outcome).
